court: In the High Court of Madras
case_number: Crl.O.P. No. 27452 of 2022 and Crl.MP. Nos. 16887 & 16888 of 2022
prayer: Prayer: Criminal Original petition filed under Section 482 of CrPC praying to call for the records in STC No. 2198 of 2021 pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Mannargudi and to quash the same as illegal.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

G.K. Ilanthiraiyan, J.:— This criminal original petition has been filed praying to quash the proceedings in STC No. 2198 of 2021 pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Mannargudi.

2. On perusal of records, it is revealed that the petitioner is arrayed as accused in the complaint lodged by the respondent in STC No. 2198 of 2021 pending on the file of the Judicial Magistrate, Mannargudi for the offence punishable under Section 138 of NI Act. Further, the petitioner was absent before the trial court and as such, bailable warrant is pending against the petitioner. When the bailable warrant is pending, this criminal original petition cannot be entertained and on this sole ground, this criminal original petition is liable to be dismissed.

3. Accordingly, this criminal original petition is dismissed. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
